prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Sugar Land, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1431; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Good afternoon. This is the adjuster calling about the claim for the sideswipe accident in Sugar Land. Is this a good time to record a short statement?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Thank you. Please state your full name for the recording.

A: [Claimant name]. Wait, I was asked not to use names, so I'll just say I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: Understood. Can you describe what happened when the collision occurred?

A: I was in the right lane on a multi-lane road in Sugar Land and wanted to move into the left lane to make a turn ahead. I checked my mirror and glanced over my shoulder. As I started to move over, another vehicle came up alongside me and its side scraped mine.

Q: Did you see that vehicle before you began changing lanes?

A: Not clearly. It was in a blind spot, and I didn't notice it until I felt the contact.

Q: Where did the contact happen on your vehicle?

A: Along the passenger side, toward the rear door and the back quarter panel.

Q: Did you stop after the contact?

A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder and waited. The other driver stopped as well, and we exchanged information.

Q: How are you feeling since the accident?

A: My neck is stiff and sore, and my lower back aches, especially when I sit for a long time. I saw a doctor the following day and was told it looks like a strain.

Q: Have you missed any work or been limited in daily activities?

A: I've had to take a few days off and I avoid lifting anything heavy. Sleeping has been uncomfortable.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add before we finish?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'll send over the medical paperwork when I have it.

Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the statement.
